title: Hindustan Coca Cola Holdings IPO
summary: Hindustan Coca Cola Holdings IPO is a book-built issue of 99.75 crore shares, proposed to be listed on BSE and NSE. The IPO dates, price band and lot size are yet to be announced.

sections.h: Hindustan Coca Cola Holdings Financials (In Crs.)

b.p: Hindustan Coca Cola Holdings financials show revenue growth and profitability trends over recent years, indicating business stability.

Incorporated on February 21, 1997, Hindustan Coca Cola Holdings Ltd. belongs to the non-alcoholic ready-to-drink (NARTD) beverages industry through its Material Subsidiary Hindustan Coca-Cola Beverages (HCCB). The Company is the largest NARTD beverage company which works only in India based on revenues for Financial Year 2026 and the largest bottler of the Coca-Cola System in India based on units of concentrate sold. As of June 30, 2026, the product range of the Company comprised 41 products distributed in three categories: Sparkling that consists of carbonated soft drinks and energy beverages. Among them there are popular brands such as Coca-Cola, Thums Up, Sprite, Fanta, Maaza, Kinley, Minute Maid, Monster and Schweppes. · · The Company operates in 10 states and four Union Territories within exclusive TCCC territories that cover key consumer markets of southern and western India. The Company has 2,273 distributors along with traditional and modern trade channels, 572,973 branded visicoolers and sales force of 5,690 people as of June 30, 2026. · · As of June 30, 2026, the Company had 5,009 employees.

The Coca-Cola Co., Hindustan Coca-Cola Overseas Holdings Pte.Ltd., Jubilant Beverages Ltd., Jubilant Bevco Ltd., Shyam Sunder Bhartia, Hari Shanker Bhartia, Arjun Shanker Bhartia, Shamit Bhartia, Shyam Sunder Bhartia Family Trust, Hari Shanker Bhartia Family Trust are the company's promoters of Hindustan Coca Cola Holdings.
